digest.component_or_area: completion verifier test harness (external bedrock lane)
propositions: The test monkeypatch closure observed_upsert has a narrow signature that does not accept evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs, causing TypeError when production code calls upsert with these kwargs during the bounded-fallback path
The anthropic/openai test arms never trigger the bounded-fallback codepath and thus avoid calling upsert with evidence_sufficient, masking the signature mismatch as bedrock-only arm-flakiness
The fix threads all kwargs through the test stub via **kwargs forwarding (except source which is used for bookkeeping), restoring parity with the real CriterionBank.upsert signature
A shared helper make_observed_upsert in tests/_bank_observer.py replaces the narrow test closure to eliminate signature drift across all completion-verifier tests
